facts.fact: Adwave's page states that it is 5 to 10 times cheaper to win back an existing customer than to acquire a new one (no source attributed).
facts.quote: It is **5 to 10 times cheaper to win back an existing customer than to acquire a new one**

facts.fact: Constant Contact's guidance on re-engaging lapsed customers identifies sending a dedicated 'We Miss You' message at the 90-day mark as the industry sweet spot.
facts.quote: sending a dedicated “We Miss You” message at the **90-day mark** is identified as the industry sweet spot in

facts.fact: According to Alexander Jarvis's overview of customer win-back rates, most businesses achieve a 10 to 30% win-back success rate.
facts.quote: **most businesses achieve a 10 to 30% win-back success rate**

facts.fact: According to Alexander Jarvis's overview, customers inactive for 3 to 6 months are the most winnable, while those inactive for 9 to 12 months are unlikely to be re-engaged.
facts.value: 3 to 6 months (most winnable); 9 to 12 months (unlikely to re-engage)
facts.quote: customers inactive for **3 to 6 months** being the most winnable, while those inactive for **9 to 12 months** are unlikely to be re-engaged

facts.fact: According to Dotdigital's guide to customer win-back programs, win-back emails that include a specific offer have a 2.09% redemption rate, compared with 0.51% for win-back emails without an offer.
facts.quote: **Win-back emails that include a specific offer have a 2.09% redemption rate, compared with 0.51% for win-back emails without an offer**

facts.fact: Per Rivo's analysis, win-back campaigns can deliver a 6x ROI when strategically targeting high-value customers through RFM segmentation.
facts.quote: Win-back campaigns can deliver a 6x ROI when strategically targeting high-value customers through RFM segmentation, and multi-touch sequences of 3 to 5 emails have proven most effective
